# Sitewell

> Sitewell looks after websites for UK businesses: finding and fixing issues, improving SEO and content, and monitoring visibility in Google and sampled AI search answers.

Ross is the Doncaster-based web developer behind Sitewell. Customers receive managed website improvements and ongoing support, rather than having to implement recommendations themselves. The free website audit is the starting point for identifying what to work on. Search estimates and sampled AI observations are indicators, not guarantees of rankings, traffic or AI recommendations.
